items.reason: Agrees with haiku. Queen Amidala needs 'If you control an upgraded base'; Hopeful Volunteer's Piloting only attaches to 'a friendly Vehicle', and Experience or Shield tokens go on units, so nothing here upgrades a base.
Agrees with haiku. Mortar Trooper's 'Deal 1 damage to each of up to 3 ground units' creates damaged units (own or enemy) and War Juggernaut 'gets +1/+0 for each damaged unit'; both are ground.

Agrees with haiku. Always Two says 'Defeat all other friendly units', a drawback not a payoff that grows with fodder, and it only keeps its 2 chosen Sith units; a Spy token (and only 'If you have the initiative') adds nothing it wants.

Agrees with haiku. Protectorate Fighter's 'create a Mandalorian token' gives a friendly unit for Chimaera's 'choose a friendly unit and an enemy non-leader unit. If you do, defeat those units', so the token is the cheap sacrifice.
Agrees with haiku. Unauthorized Investigation only says 'Create a Spy token' (and a second one on disclose); it makes its own tokens and nothing in its text rewards existing tokens.

Agrees with haiku. Milodon Rider's 'You may return another friendly non-leader unit to its owner's hand' can return Krrsantan, whose 'When Played: You may deal damage ... to a ground unit' can then be replayed.
Agrees with haiku. Forced Pacification's 'Defeat any number of friendly units' can defeat Executor, triggering 'When Defeated: Create 3 TIE Fighter tokens'.
Agrees with haiku. Jedi Trials says 'Attach to a Force unit' and Adept of Anger has the printed Force trait, so it is a legal host.
Agrees with haiku. Aggressive Negotiations' 'Attack with a unit' can choose Rho Medical Shuttle, firing its 'When Played/On Attack: You may heal 1 damage' On Attack half.

Overrides haiku (unsure to correct): Children of the Watch makes 2 Mandalorian tokens, which are extra friendly units, and The Student Guides the Master gives '+1/+0 ... for each other friendly unit with less power than it'; tokens are low-power bodies (printed 2 power or less), so they raise the count for a bigger target such as the 3-power Children.
Agrees with haiku. Sith Holocron says 'Attach to a Force unit' and Dooku has the printed Force trait.

Agrees with haiku. Skyway Cloud Car's 'When Defeated: You may return a non-leader unit with 2 or less power' can return your own 1-power Ferry Droid, whose 'When Played: Give 4 Advantage tokens to this unit' is then replayed.
Agrees with haiku. Rhydonium Detonation's 'defeat all non-leader units' defeats Executor and fires its 'When Defeated: Create 3 TIE Fighter tokens'.
Agrees with haiku. Darth Maul's Lightsaber only attacks 'If attached unit is Darth Maul'; Captain Phasma is a different unit, and the attach restriction ('non-Vehicle') does not change that.
Agrees with haiku. Dornean Gunship is printed Vehicle and Rose Tico says 'Heal 2 damage from a Vehicle unit that attacked this phase'.
Agrees with haiku. Red Squadron Y-Wing is printed Rebel and Fulcrum gives 'Each other friendly Rebel unit +2/+2'.

Overrides haiku (correct to wrong): Industrious Team only defeats 'a non-leader unit with 4 or less remaining HP' and CR90 Relief Runner has 6 HP, so it is not a legal target unless already damaged by 2; it is not an on-demand sacrifice outlet for CR90's When Defeated.

Agrees with haiku. Shatterpoint's second mode ('Use the Force ... defeat a non-leader unit') can defeat a friendly unit, enabling Koska Reeves' 'If a friendly unit was defeated this phase, create a Mandalorian token'.
Agrees with haiku. Fulminatrix is printed First Order and Captain Phasma gives 'another First Order unit +2/+2 for this phase'.

Agrees with haiku. Darth Sion's only When Defeated is 'If this unit had 7 or more power, return him', and nothing in his text repeats or rewards other units' When Defeated abilities; the want is only curated.
Agrees with haiku. Reanimated Night Trooper has 'When Defeated: Look at the top card of a deck', which Chimaera's 'You may use a When Defeated ability on another friendly unit' can use.

Overrides haiku (correct to wrong): Nameless Terror's 'You may exhaust a Force unit' is useful aimed at an enemy, and its On Attack makes enemies 'lose the Force trait'; a friendly Marrok is only a bad target, so the right side fails.

Agrees with haiku. Refugee of The Path has 'When Played: You may give a Shield token to a unit with Sentinel' (it has Sentinel itself, so it always has a target) and Aethersprite says 'you may use that ability again'.
Agrees with haiku. Elzar Mann needs 'a Force leader'; Ben Kenobi is a non-leader unit, so his Force trait does not satisfy it.
Agrees with haiku. The Ghost is printed Vehicle and L3-37 'may instead attach her as an upgrade to a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot'.
